forms = "" : subforms = "" : pages = "" : framesets = "" : outlines = ""

REMINDER FORM FIELDS '  out = out & Chr(10) & "=== REMINDER FORM FIELDS ===" & Chr(10) On Error Resume Next Set remForm = db.GetForm("Reminder") If Not remForm Is Nothing Then remFields = remForm.Fields For j = 0 To UBound(remFields) out = out & " - " & remFields(j) & Chr(10) Next j Else out = out & " (Reminder form not found)" & Chr(10) End If On Error GoTo 0

stream.Position = 0 dxl = stream.ReadText()
fileNum2 = FreeFile() Open "D:\Claude\DB_NSF\QA_PanCen\11_PIMSWI_all_dxl.xml" For Output As #fileNum2 chunkSize = 65536 pos = 1 Do While pos <= Len(dxl) Print #fileNum2, Mid(dxl, pos, chunkSize); pos = pos + chunkSize Loop Close #fileNum2
